# Cobblemon data fixtures

These four species folders are copies of `data/cobblemon/species/**`,
`dex_entries/**` and `spawn_pool_world/**` from Cobblemon 1.8.4, used only so
the pokedex tests run without the mod jar. Cobblemon's data and code are
licensed under the Mozilla Public License 2.0 by the Cobblemon contributors
(https://gitlab.com/cable-mc/cobblemon). No models, textures, animations or
sounds are included here; those carry a separate license and never enter
this repository.
